renderer_boundary.handoff_note: FrankenEngine owns proof-reader JSON/text semantics only; any rich interactive renderer belongs in /dp/frankentui.

authority_sources.authority_role: authoritative claim rows, allowed wording state, owning bead, artifact path, verification command, source span, downgrade text
human companion only; not stronger than matrix JSON
gate verdicts, reason strings, failure taxonomy, downgrade text
bundle completeness, manifest, event log, commands transcript, replay pointers
release, performance, conformance, and claim-support payloads
runtime trace explanation and decision/event context when present
data ingress, purpose binding, declassification routes, non-use certificate context
explicit uncertified, degraded, fail-closed, or out-of-scope E8 refusal evidence
read-only owning bead status and dependency context

cli_exit_policy.rationale: unsupported and not_promotable receipts are readable explanations, not successful validation outcomes

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Claim id absent from claim_to_proof_matrix_v1.json
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Add or correct the matrix row before explaining the claim

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Claim matrix schema missing or unsupported
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Regenerate or fix the matrix and rerun the claim gate

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Claim matrix path is missing, unreadable, or invalid JSON
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Read or regenerate the claim-to-proof matrix, then rerun the claim gate

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: A claim matrix row omits a field required for its wording state
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Fill the required matrix fields before explaining the claim

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: More than one claim matrix row has the requested claim id
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Deduplicate the matrix row before explaining the claim

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: allowed_state or actual_wording_state is outside hypothesis, target, or observed
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Use the supported wording states before explaining the claim

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Actual wording is stronger than the matrix allows
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Downgrade the wording or promote it only after upstream proof gates pass

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: The matrix row is target or hypothesis, not observed proof
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Keep the explanation degraded or not_promotable until observed proof artifacts are linked

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: .beads/issues.jsonl and derived DB disagree, or tracker freshness cannot be established
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Run the documented Beads sync/import/export path and re-read state

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Required artifact path is missing
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Produce or attach the upstream gate bundle

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Observed proof artifact is present but lacks a nearby repro.lock
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Add a reproducibility bundle before treating the claim as supported

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Matrix expected hash is not sha256:<64-hex> or bare 64-hex
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Replace the expected artifact hash or omit it until an authority source exists

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Matrix expected hash does not match the artifact bytes
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Regenerate the artifact from the recorded replay command or correct the matrix hash authority

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Claim-level freshness budget or observed artifact freshness is stale or unknown
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Refresh the observed proof artifact or downgrade the claim before treating it as supported

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Required bundle member such as run_manifest.json, events.jsonl, or commands.txt is absent
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Re-run the upstream gate or point at a complete preserved bundle

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Bundle manifest JSON/TOML cannot be parsed as an object
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Fix the manifest syntax/schema before using the bundle as evidence

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Bundle manifest required_members is empty, contains entries without non-empty string paths, declares malformed or conflicting member hashes, or uses non-boolean required flags
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Fix the manifest so required members are explicit root-relative paths or path objects with boolean required flags and valid, non-conflicting SHA-256 hex hash fields

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: A bundle manifest member path resolves outside the declared bundle root
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Reject the bundle and regenerate it with root-relative member paths only

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Bundle schema or version outside the V1 allowlist
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Add schema support in a future bead or use a supported bundle

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Declared hash does not match available bytes
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Treat artifact as untrusted and regenerate from source

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: MockCertificate, hot_paths_simulation, placeholder, or fixture-only evidence backs an observed proof claim
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Replace with a live or preserved non-mock proof artifact

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Heavy proof command used local Cargo or non-remote fallback where the contract requires rch
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Re-run through rch and attach the remote proof bundle

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Matrix or receipt says observed/done while owning bead is blocked/open without an explicit exception
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Resolve tracker status or downgrade the claim

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Upstream artifact claims replayability but has no exact replay command
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Regenerate bundle with command transcript and replay metadata

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Bundle manifest declares replay command fields with non-string or empty string values
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Fix the manifest so every declared replay command is an exact non-empty command string

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Freshness exceeds upstream maximum, cannot be computed, or any declared freshness alias is stale or malformed
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Regenerate evidence or emit degraded state

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: E8 certificate or capstone artifact is not yet available
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Emit degraded or non-promotable E8 report until certifier surfaces land

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: E8 refusal ledger has refusal codes or a non-certifiable result class
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Preserve refusal code, class, source reference, and remediation while blocking positive non-use wording

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Refusal ledger has invalid schema, unknown refusal code or class, or an unresolved refusal source reference
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Treat the ledger as untrusted and rerun the E8 preflight or capstone producer

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: E8 route, binding, claim, purpose, or data-source id repeats where uniqueness is required
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Fix the data contract or certifier input and rerun upstream validation

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: E8 certificate references a claim id absent from the matrix
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Add or correct matrix linkage or reject the certificate report

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Matrix source span has invalid one-based line numbers
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Use one-based source span line numbers with start_line <= end_line

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Matrix source path cannot be located
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Restore the source path or update the matrix before treating the claim as supported

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Matrix source path exists but cannot be read
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Make the source readable or update the matrix before explaining the claim

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Matrix must_contain text is absent from the declared source span
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Update the source span or downgrade the claim until source text matches

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Source line references cannot be located
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Preserve path-only source ref and mark line span unavailable

fail_closed_reason_codes.trigger: Input family is outside the V1 contract
fail_closed_reason_codes.remediation: Add an explicit future contract extension before trusting it

truth_constraints: Explainers are advisory proof readers, not proof authorities.
Supported decisions must not promote target or hypothesis claims.
CLI and smoke/gate wrappers may exit zero only for supported or explicitly degraded receipts.
Missing, stale, contradictory, mock-contaminated, local-fallback, or unsupported evidence must fail closed or degrade explicitly.
Replay commands may be reported but must not be auto-executed by the explainer.
E8 certificate reports remain degraded or not_promotable until certifier and capstone artifacts exist.
Explicit E8 refusal ledgers must be reported as refusal evidence, not as missing certifier evidence.
No positive E8 non-use wording may be emitted when a refusal ledger has refusal codes or a non-certifiable result class.
Future rich interactive UI must reuse /dp/frankentui.
Any Cargo validation added by child beads must run through rch and reject local fallback.
